name: Product Certification (ISI Mark)
description: The flagship ISI Mark scheme operated under Scheme-I of BIS Conformity Assessment Regulations 2018. Ensures product safety, quality, and reliability through factory audits, sample testing, and continuous surveillance.
keySteps: Submit application on Manakonline portal
Factory audit by BIS inspecting officer
Drawing samples & testing in BIS/NABL recognized laboratory
Grant of License (GoL) upon satisfactory test report
Periodic surveillance and market sample testing

name: Hallmarking Scheme (Gold & Silver)
description: Guarantees official purity and fineness of gold and silver jewellery. Features 6-digit alphanumeric Hallmark Unique Identification (HUID) laser etched at authorized Assaying & Hallmarking Centres (AHC).
keySteps: Jeweller registration on BIS portal
Submission of jewellery batch to accredited AHC
Fire assay testing and XRF non-destructive screening
Laser engraving of BIS logo, purity grade, and 6-digit HUID code
Consumer verification via BIS CARE Mobile App

name: Laboratory Recognition Scheme (LIMS)
description: BIS operates 8 Central/Regional laboratories and recognizes hundreds of independent NABL-accredited commercial and government laboratories under the Laboratory Recognition Scheme (LRS).
keySteps: Application via LIMS portal
Assessment of technical competence & ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation
On-site audit by BIS technical assessors
Inter-laboratory proficiency testing (PT)
Grant of BIS recognition status for specified Indian Standards

name: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
description: Simplified registration scheme (Scheme-II) for electronics and IT products based on self-declaration of conformity supported by test reports from BIS recognized labs.
keySteps: Test product in BIS recognized lab in India
Obtain valid test report
Submit online application on CRS portal with affidavit of conformity
Grant of Registration (R-number assigned)
Affix CRS logo with R-Number on product packaging

name: BIS Standards Clubs in Schools & Colleges
description: Educational initiative establishing Standards Clubs across high schools and engineering colleges to instill quality consciousness, standard drafting awareness, and consumer rights in students.
keySteps: Institution registration with BIS Regional Office
Formation of Student Club with Mentor Teacher
Organizing industrial exposure visits, quizzes, and competitions
Financial grant support from BIS for club activities

name: National Institute of Training for Standardization (NITS)
description: NITS Noida provides training programs on standardization, quality management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 22000), laboratory management, and auditing techniques.
targetAudience: Quality Managers, Industry Executives, Lead Auditors
keySteps: Browse course directory on NITS portal
Select online or classroom training module
Complete registration & payment
Attend training and pass evaluation assessment
Receive BIS NITS Certificate

name: Consumer Affairs & BIS Care App
description: Enables consumers to verify authenticity of ISI Mark, CRS Registration, and Gold HUID codes, as well as lodge complaints regarding substandard products or misuse of BIS marks.
keySteps: Download BIS CARE App from Play Store / App Store
Enter HUID or ISI License / R-Number
View instant verification status and manufacturer details
Lodge complaint with photos/location if non-compliant
